coverage.finding: Ink page number '127' with a superscript 'b' at the top left. The candidate's reading and annotation are correct.

Two-line note in small cursive, item lists (1) to (7). The wording matches the image. One date digit is not secure: the image reads 'S. 1916' or 'S. 1926', and the literal text and date field state '1926' without a marker. In items (3) and (5) the source appears to write 'ff1-60' and 'ff1-32' with no stop. That is a minor punctuation point and is left as is. Both items (4) and (5) read 'vi' as written. They are not corrected.
Single line 'ff. 1-101, sargas i-xi, text only'. The candidate's tentative readings are appropriate. The leftward arrow at about canvas x 3045-3165, y 2428 is aligned with c. 171 on fol. 128.

Single line. The word before 'i only' reads 'Stabaka', matching 'Stabaka 1 only' on the facing fol. 128 line. The inventory's 'Śataka' is not supported. The candidate keeps a [reading?] marker, which is appropriate. 'I.O. 2129' is legible; the second letter could be read as '0'.

unresolved.issue: Several readings are not secure: 'S. 1926' versus 'S. 1916', '1-109' versus '1-104', '1-134' versus '1-136', and the numerals 'vi' in items (4) and (5).
unresolved.next_check: Examine a higher-resolution or enhanced image of canvas region x 2700-3100, y 1990-2050 for the date, and the earlier part of that line for the folio ranges.

unresolved.issue: The parent attachments to fol. 128 entries c. 173, c. 171 and c. 202(7) rest on arrow alignment across the gutter. Each arrow has an arrowhead segment on this page and a separate dash on the facing page.
unresolved.next_check: Confirm the arrow continuity in an image of the full spread at native resolution.

review.boundary_review: The gutter lies at about canvas x 3170-3210. Everything to the right belongs to fol. 128 and is not transcribed here. That includes 'd.88', '√ d. 1', 'd.', 'ā/', 'a/', ticks, the X mark, the arrow tail dashes and the overlapping repeat of '(5) ff1-32, vi, 1-62:' visible on the fol. 128 image. No fragment of fol. 127 appears. The three notes on this page are additions linked to fol. 128 entries, not independent holdings.

region_review.top: Page number '127b' only. The ruled lines carry faint show-through, which is not text.
region_review.middle: b002 and b003 are present, each with a leftward arrow near the gutter. There are small specks near canvas [450,810] and [770,1790].
region_review.bottom: b004 and its arrow near y 4000. Below that there is only faint show-through and a speck; no bottom note.
region_review.right_margin: Three arrowheads near the gutter, and a small stroke near [3155,660] that is not text. The text beyond the gutter belongs to fol. 128.
region_review.interlinear: No interlinear additions or cancellations are visible on the target page.
